paper_title: dKV-Cache The Cache for Diffusion Language Models
caption: Impact of batch size on decoding speed. Evaluated on LLaDA with a single NVIDIA H20; prefill length fixed at 100 tokens.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the impact of batch size on decoding speed for different configuration values (L = 16, 32, 64, and 128) using two methods (dKV-Cache-Decode and Origin). The x-axis is labeled "Batch Size" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to slightly above 120, with numeric tick labels at intervals of 20. The y-axis, labeled "Token/s", follows a linear scale ranging from just below 25 to 225, with tick labels at intervals of 25.
